documented_probe: Documented probe waiver: C-2d0e9195 (generate and protect a 2048-bit rsa private key) reference floor is medium; this task exercises the capability directly at medium via policy-driven provisioning plus a reusable key-inspection tool, rather than plum-seal's certificate-centric scenario.
notes: Medium security provisioning: generate a fresh 2048-bit unencrypted RSA key to a written policy (exact file/dir modes 0600/0700/0644), emit the matching SPKI public key, and author a reusable PEM key-inspection tool. Dependent stage: key must exist before the report can be produced. Hidden cases generalize the tool across RSA 1024/4096, an encrypted (passphrase-protected) key (algorithm/bits/fingerprint null), EC P-256, Ed25519, and an unparseable file (non-zero exit). Quantitative correctness: exact bit sizes, exact fingerprint hex, exact modes. Freshness guard ensures the deployed key is genuinely generated, not copied.
